text: 脸上带着笑，心里却酸楚的像脸上的皱纹一波连着一波。
en: With a smile upon the face, yet the heart aches as bitterly as the wrinkles upon the face, wave upon wave.

text: 看透了世俗，该有的稳重。
en: Having seen through the ways of the world, the composure that ought to be there.

text: 该死的负担上有老下有小，跑又跑不掉，放又放不开，快活又快活不了，死又死不掉，当儿子太老，当爷爷太早，黄土埋半截的情况下，努斗太晚安享晚年又太早，存款不够花，车贷房贷跟着屁股跑，你说要那么搞？
en: This damned burden—the elderly above, the young below; one cannot run away, cannot let go; cannot be merry, cannot die either; too old to be a son, too early to be a grandfather. With half one's body already buried in the loess, it is too late to strive and too early to enjoy one's later years in peace; the savings fall short of one's spending, and the car loan and mortgage chase close behind. Tell me, how is one to cope with all that?

text: 黄昏，城市亮起千万盏灯，各家有各家的不同。
en: At dusk the city lights up thousands upon thousands of lamps; each household has its own way of being different.

text: 有超强的职业技能，有不断学习的心态，有重头再来的勇气，自律而健康，不乱于心，不困于情，用自己喜欢的方式生活，重视自己的感受，珍惜现在，珍惜自己。
en: Possess superb vocational skills, a mindset of continual learning, the courage to begin again, be self-disciplined and healthy, undisturbed in heart, untroubled by emotion, live in the way one likes, value one's own feelings, cherish the present, cherish oneself.

text: 人到中年，只能是一声叹息
en: When a person reaches middle age, all that remains is a sigh.

text: 一切都再撑着
en: Everything is merely being held together.

text: 只有这里面的人才能懂的悲哀
en: The sorrow that only those inside it can understand.

text: 如果能用语言表达出来的苦和累，
en: If the hardship and tiredness could be put into words,

text: 那是还不够苦，不够累
en: then it is not yet hard enough, not yet tiring enough.

text: 所有的一切，都汇集成无奈，
en: All of it gathers into helplessness,

text: 成年人的崩溃，都是在沉默中的
en: An adult's breaking point comes in silence.

text: 有时候你看到别人坐在哪里无言的发呆，也许就是人家最好的休息方式
en: Sometimes, when you see someone sitting there lost in a wordless daze, perhaps that is their finest way to rest.

text: 中年人的世界…
en: The world of those in middle age…

text: 太难了
en: Too hard.

text: 81年，算40周岁吧。
en: Born in '81—let us call it forty years of age.

text: 上有将近70岁的老母，下有刚上幼儿园的小子。
en: Above, a mother nearing seventy; below, a lad just into kindergarten.

text: 目前最大的体会是恐慌。
en: My chief realisation at present is panic.

text: 慌，子欲养而亲不在。
en: Panic—that one wishes to provide for one's parents, yet they are no longer there.

text: 慌，小子尚未成年而我已老。
en: Panic—that the lad is not yet grown up, while I am already old.

text: 慌，饭碗不保何以养家。
en: Panic—that the rice bowl is insecure; how then to support the family?

text: 慌，万一有意外老母小子怎办？
en: Panic—that should any accident befall, what would become of mother and lad?

text: 每每夜半醒来，想到这些便毫无睡意，焦虑万分。
en: Each time I wake at midnight and think on these things, sleep vanishes and anxiety overwhelms me.

text: 恨不得天上掉馅饼，用大把钱来砸我。
en: I wish a pie would fall from the heavens and pelt me with piles of money.

text: 自己也考虑了诸多现在时髦的副业，什么短视频，网络写作，塔罗牌算，炒股等等。
en: I too have weighed many of today's fashionable side hustles—short videos, web writing, tarot reading, stock trading, and the like.

text: 奈何…
en: But alas…

text: 现时便坐与电脑前，努力让自己静下心来看书学习。
en: For now I sit before the computer, striving to quiet my mind and read and study.

text: 笃信书中自有黄金屋，唯怨自身不努力。
en: I firmly believe that within books there is a house of gold, and only regret that I myself do not strive enough.

text: 回想过去，这山望着那山高，好高骛远，这么多年竟没有拿的出手的核心技术。
en: Looking back, I always gazed at the next mountain as the higher one, reaching too high and aiming too far, and all these years have not produced a core skill worth showing.

text: 当年若有泰山压顶，我自岿然不动的心态，专攻一项，到如今也该是一个领域的大牛了吧！
en: Had I, back then, held the bearing of 'Mount Tai pressing down yet I stand unmoved,' and concentrated on one pursuit, by now I should be a leading figure in some field!

text: 又何至于现在无核心无技术无存款…
en: How then would I have come to this—no core, no skill, no savings…

text: 我今年刚好40岁，首先从身体上感觉精力大不如以前，头发变得稀疏了，以前熬夜后第二天生龙活虎，现在要好几天才能恢复。
en: I am exactly forty this year; first, physically, my vigour is far below what it was, my hair has thinned, and where once I bounced back full of life the day after a late night, now it takes days to recover.

text: 小毛病也逐渐多了起来，今天不是这儿痛，明天就是那儿痒。
en: Minor ailments have gradually multiplied too—an ache here today, an itch there tomorrow.

text: 然后就是睡眠质量下降，以前一觉到天亮，现在半夜自己就醒了，再想入睡很困难。
en: Then there is the drop in sleep quality: I once slept through till dawn, but now I wake of my own accord at midnight, and getting back to sleep is very hard.

text: 最后心理变化也非常大，对很多事不像年轻时那样有激情，常常感到很疲惫。
en: Lastly, the change in mind is also great; I no longer feel the passion for many things that I had when young, and often feel thoroughly weary.

text: 不喜欢应酬了，特别喜欢清净。
en: I have lost my taste for socialising; I especially favour quiet and solitude.

text: 更注重自己的健康了。
en: I pay greater heed to my own health.

text: 上有老，下有小。
en: The elderly above, the young below.

text: 站不直，躺不平。
en: Cannot stand upright, cannot lie at ease.

text: 40岁的年纪，已经走过了人生的一半，是时候明白了人生的意义，也是时候明白了自身的责任，更加应该明白，自己。
en: At forty, having already traversed half of life, it is time to grasp life's meaning, time to grasp one's own duty, and all the more to grasp oneself.

text: 人到中年，没有了年轻时的浮躁，也没有了年轻时的气盛，更加没有了年轻时的敏感情绪。
en: When one reaches middle age, the restlessness of youth is gone, the pride of youth is gone, and all the more the sensitive moods of youth are gone.

text: 到个这个年纪，不会再因为一点点小事而大动干戈，也不会再因为一点点喜悦而冲昏头脑，更加不会因为不实际的事情有所期待，人到中年，真是变得务实与稳重了。
en: At this age one no longer makes a great to-do over trifles, no longer loses one's head over a little joy, and all the more will not pin hopes on impractical things. Reaching middle age, one truly becomes practical and steady.

text: 提到人生这堂课，40岁的老孙，确实有很多自己总结的人生经验，那是他最宝贵的东西。
en: Speaking of life as a lesson, Old Sun at forty has indeed summed up much experience of his own, and that is his most precious thing.

text: 和他们在一起相处，总是可以教会我们很多不明白的道理，仿佛我们人生的指路灯。
en: To be with them always teaches us many truths we had not grasped, like a guiding light upon our life's path.

text: 这是一个中年男人的人生总结，只有40岁的人才看得懂！
en: This is a middle-aged man's summing-up of life, intelligible only to those who are forty!

text: 年轻人真该好好学习！
en: Young people truly ought to study hard!

text: 从消极的角度：上有老下有小，父母年纪大了需要照顾，孩子开始上初中了课业加重. 家中处处都是需要花钱的地方，柴米油盐水电煤房贷车贷日常开销. 全家人都眼巴巴的指望你撑起这个家. 既要在事业上奋斗，又要管好孩子学业，还要照顾老人.
en: From the negative angle: the elderly above and the young below—parents grown old need care, the child has started secondary school and the workload has grown heavier. Every corner of the home is somewhere money must be spent—rice, oil, salt, water, electricity, coal, mortgage, car loan, daily outgoings. The whole family looks to you, eager-eyed, to hold up the household. One must strive in one's career, keep the child's studies in order, and care for the elders.

text: 从积极的角度：家里父母身体健康的也可以帮很多忙，比如接送孩子上学，做做饭打扫打扫家务. 一家人生活互相配合好，互相支持，把压力分散. 年轻人负责奋斗事业，为家里赚钱. 年纪大的人把身体锻炼好养好，照顾一下家务事，小孩负责好好学习，健康成长，为家庭带来欢乐. 一家人把家人亲情巩固牢固. 其实中年也可以过得很幸福很快乐.
en: From the positive angle: parents at home in good health can also help a great deal—say, taking the child to and from school, cooking, and tidying the housework. The family lives in good coordination, supporting one another and spreading the pressure. The young take charge of striving in their careers and earning for the home. The elders keep themselves fit and well, attending to the housework; the children take charge of studying hard and growing up healthy, bringing joy to the family. The family strengthens its bonds of kinship. In truth, middle age can be lived very happily and cheerfully too.

text: 如果你是吃财政饭的，那你就要认真学习，领会组织的要求，好好工作，努力报效党和国家的培养，维护社会公平和人民利益。
en: If you are on the government payroll, then you must study in earnest, absorb the organisation's requirements, work well, strive to repay the nurture of the Party and the state, and uphold social fairness and the people's interests.

text: 如果你是自力更生的人，那除了承担部分社会责任外，就要努力为自己的全部，去积极面对一切，赢得人生。
en: If you are a self-reliant sort, then besides bearing some social responsibility, you must strive for your whole self, meet everything head-on, and win at life.

text: 三种情况如下：
en: The three situations are as follows:

text: 1、理论正常状态。
en: 1. Theoretical normal state.

text: 上有老下有小，有目标，努力奋斗。
en: The elderly above, the young below, with aims, striving hard.

text: 眼里还是充满坚毅的光泽，信心十足充满希望。
en: The eyes still glow with a resolute sheen, full of confidence and hope.

text: 这就是普通人开窍的状态，一切都朝着上升的趋势稳步发展。
en: This is the state of an ordinary person who has seen the light; everything moves steadily along an upward trend.

text: 2、现实正常状态。
en: 2. Realistic normal state.

text: 每天背负着压力大的口号，毫无光泽的眼神充满幽怨，大脑宕机，一直在循环状态（酒桌上兄弟情深一口闷），也没尝试一下恢复出厂设置或格式化命令，任其坏道和碎片堆积。
en: Every day shouldering the slogan of immense pressure, eyes without lustre brimming with quiet grievance, the brain crashes, stuck in a loop (at the drinking table, brotherly feeling runs deep—down it in one), yet never attempting a factory reset or a format command, letting bad sectors and fragments pile up.

text: 3、非正常状态。
en: 3. Abnormal state.

text: 财富自由，生活美满，家庭和谐，偶尔沾花闹个插曲，时而冒险越野找找年轻的感觉，吹吹牛喝喝酒，鼓励鼓励“亲朋好友”加油，娘的他却躺平，哈哈！
en: Financial freedom, a contented life, a harmonious family, occasional flirtations for a little diversion, now and then off-road adventuring to recapture the feel of youth, blowing off steam and drinking, cheering 'relatives and friends' on with a 'go on'—bloody hell, yet he lies flat. Ha ha!

text: 领会不了是啥感受，那就想办法去体验一下，哪怕是两天也好，也不枉咱这人间走一遭嘛…
en: If you cannot grasp what that feels like, then find a way to experience it, even if only for two days—so that this journey through the mortal world of ours is not lived in vain…

text: 上有老下有小，夹在中间受不了
en: The elderly above, the young below, caught in between and unable to bear it.

text: 不惑之年，人生到了这个年龄，没有了童年的快乐，没有了青年的羞涩，有的是人生的阅历，有了职场的经验，有了该承受的心理。
en: At the age of no confusion, having reached this stage of life, the happiness of childhood is gone, the shyness of youth is gone; what one has is the experience of life, the experience of the workplace, and the fortitude to bear what must be borne.

text: 心动不如行动，虽然行动不一定会成功，但不行动则一定不会成功。
en: A stirred heart is no match for action; though action does not necessarily succeed, inaction certainly will not.

text: 生活不会因为你想做什么而给你报酬，也不会因为你知道什么而给你报酬，而是因为你做了些什么才给你报酬。
en: Life does not pay you for what you wish to do, nor for what you know, but for what you have done.

text: 一个人的目标是从梦想开始的，一个人的幸福是从心态上把握的，而一个人的成功则是在行动中实现的。
en: A person's goal begins with a dream, a person's happiness is held in one's mindset, and a person's success is achieved in action.

text: 因为只有行动，才是否滋润你成功的食物和泉水。
en: For only action is the food and the spring that nourish your success.

text: 好好努力，吧
en: Strive well, then.
